text:
Sophie: Quick heads up — I left around 7pm and front desk mentioned an unexpected guest ended up staying in the lobby overnight. Name Daniel Park, box marked 'glass samples'. Did we issue a temp badge for him? :thinking_face:

frontdesk-bot: Log entry: guest arrived 2026-03-22 18:45. Host: Sophie M. Temp lanyard issued: yes. Badge ID: TEMP-23. Parcel stored in 'Received - bulky' locker B2. NDA signed on check-in tablet.

frontdesk-bot: ```
Badge info:
Name: Daniel Park
Company: Ozone Labs
Badge: TEMP-23
Locker: B2 (Received - bulky)
```

Sophie: Thanks — can someone pick the package before the cleaners at 10am? It's fragile and the bottom got a bit damp.

Maria: I can swing by at 9:30 and bring it to the west meeting room. @Lily can you collect from me at 10?

Lily: Yep, I’ll pick it up. Also FYI the badge printer by reception jammed earlier; there are blank lanyards in cabinet C. @Jason can you restock paper/toner?

Jason: On it. I'll bring a spare roll of badge paper and the label gun tomorrow AM. Filed a quick ops note: 'badge-printer: low toner'.

Ryan: Quick question — did the guest sign the standard NDA for prototype samples? We should ensure legal is covered.

frontdesk-bot: Check-in record shows NDA checkbox ticked and e-signature captured. Storage humidity reading: 48%. Access restricted until host confirmation.

Sophie: Perfect. Whoever grabs it — please do NOT put it in the bike room, that gets humid. Meeting room table or my desk is fine. Big thanks Maria :heart:

Maria: I'll add a bright pink sticky that says 'OZONE LABS - FRAGILE' so cleaners don't move it.

Lily: Quick non-work poll: who wants leftover bagels tomorrow? React with :bagel: on your name. (I'm calling dibs on blueberry.)

Jason: :bagel: for me. Also reminder — if you're hosting externals tomorrow morning, put the host name in the calendar event summary so front desk can pre-print badges.

frontdesk-bot: Reminder: badge printer maintenance scheduled 2026-03-23 14:00-14:30. Expect limited printing; use temporary lanyards if needed.

Sophie: All set. Maria, huge lifesaver — coffee tomorrow from me :coffee:

Maria: Deal. See you in the AM!
